items.title: OpenAI reportedly raises another $11B at a $1.25T valuation
items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion in a funding round that has not yet closed but is expected to in the coming weeks.
items.whyItMatters: Fresh capital signals continued heavy investment in the Realtime/voice stack Romain depends on, though nothing changes for pricing today.

items.title: Nvidia to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a possible Chinese spy
items.summary: In a memo to the company, Huang admitted to an affair; Nvidia says it will investigate, following a US intelligence memo about a Megaspeed exec.
items.whyItMatters: Leadership turmoil at Nvidia could affect GPU supply and inference pricing across the voice-AI vendors the tutor relies on.
